The '''Eighth Imperial Infantry''' was an infantry unit in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The unit was part of the covert Imperial force sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], and [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Vendelik]]&mdash;a Makeb native&mdash;was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when he deviated from their assignment of stealing [[isotope-5]] in order to shut down the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] drills and save his family and friends.<ref name="RotHC" />
